archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-drift
archetypes.rationale: Changed Phase-B architectural guideline drift recovery and pin retry behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the staged architectural guideline refresh flow. Check that a fingerprint mismatch only recovers when the live diff is materialized, metadata is present, and the retry pins the same assessment text against the refreshed diff. Verify true mismatches and unavailable repo/base inputs still fail closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-artifact-safety
archetypes.rationale: The helper rewrites session artifacts that feed PR and final-summary notes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect artifact safety around staged assessment, sidecar, and diff snapshot rewrites. Pay attention to symlink and regular-file checks, dropped-note cleanup, and interactions with existing durable note invalidation behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
